title: Tiny Trails: Space
tagline: Trace a twinkly trail through ten cosmic worlds.
summary: A calm tracing game. Follow a glowing path across little planets and meet a friendly star at the end.
description: Tiny Trails: Space is a calm tracing game for ages 3 to 6. Follow a glowing trail across little planets and meet a friendly star at the end.
free_content: Free Play and the Sun, Earth, and Moon worlds, with the explorers Astro and Zog.
unlock: All 10 worlds and every explorer. No subscription.
trial: One shared 3-use trial lets your child try locked worlds and explorers first.
web_note: The browser version includes the free content.

art_alt.card: Tiny Trails: Space, a glowing stardust path across a soft lavender moon
art_alt.og: Tiny Trails: Space key art with the game title
screens: A small astronaut tracing a glowing trail across a moon path
Three tiny planets: a butter-yellow sun, a mint Earth, and a teal moon
A chibi astronaut hugging a smiling butter-yellow star

highlights.text: Trace the path with a finger. The trail lights up as the explorer moves.
Ten little worlds to visit. Free Play and the Sun, Earth, and Moon are open from the start.
Astro and Zog are free. The other explorers come with the one-time unlock.
No timers and nothing to read. Play again whenever you like.
